Declaring Func_080b0a20 directly and calling it with the 3 arguments the assembly actually passes (r0=&shop->cursor, r1=-32, r2=112, with no live r3 argument) makes that one bl instruction match the reference exactly in the aligned diff. This is real, verified-correct groundwork for the next attempt even though the headline count moved from 190/70 to 192/70: fixing the wrong callee removed a phantom 4th argument setup that had been coincidentally absorbing some of the length/alignment mismatch caused by the (still unresolved) register-spill gap documented above. The candidate.c now calls the verified-correct Func_080b0a20 callee; the remaining gap is still the same compiler-internals register/spill assignment identified above and needs permuter-style search, not manual respelling.
